program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const tTop = u / g; const t = time; const yTop = (u * u) / (2 * g); let tossH = u * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; let tossV = u - g * t; let tossA = -g; let tossState = "Rising"; if (t < 0.05) { tossState = "At launch"; } else if (Math.abs(t - tTop) < 0.05) { tossState = "At the top"; } else if (t > tTop) { tossState = "Falling"; } if (t > tTop + tTop) { tossState = "At launch height"; tossH = 0; } let dropH = yTop; let dropV = 0; let dropA = 0; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (t >= tTop) { let dt = t - tTop; dropH = yTop - 0.5 * g * dt * dt; dropV = -g * dt; dropA = -g; dropState = "Falling together"; if (Math.abs(t - tTop) < 0.05) { dropState = "Just released"; } if (dropH <= 0) { dropH = 0; dropState = "At launch height"; } } const scaleY = 120 / 2.2; const baseY = 360; const tossX = 200; const dropX = 440; const widthLane = 180; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 80, y: 60, w: widthLane, h: 320, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 60, w: widthLane, h: 320, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX, y: baseY, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX, y: baseY, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const pyToss = baseY - tossH * scaleY; const pyDrop = baseY - dropH * scaleY; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, pyToss, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, pyDrop, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 16, y: pyToss }, { value: tossV, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 16, y: pyToss }, { value: tossA, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 16, y: pyDrop }, { value: dropV, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 16, y: pyDrop }, { value: dropA, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 40, pyToss - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossV) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossA) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 40, pyDrop - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropV) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropA) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); if (t >= tTop) { objects.push(sdk.gate("gate", dropX, baseY - yTop * scaleY, { open: true, label: "Apex Gate" })); } else { objects.push(sdk.gate("gate", dropX, baseY - yTop * scaleY, { open: false, label: "Apex Gate" })); } return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossV }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossA }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropV }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropA }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, apexTime: tTop, apexHeight: yTop, tossedVelocity: tossV, tossedAcceleration: tossA, tossedHeight: tossH, dropVelocity: dropV, dropAcceleration: dropA, dropHeight: dropH } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. The gate releases a second ball at that moment. Both then fall together from rest.
manifest.description: Two equal-width lanes side by side show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. At the top of the toss, velocity is zero while acceleration remains constant at -g. A release gate lets the second ball fall from that same height.
assumptions: The same gravity for both balls
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
